The largest country in the world is Russia.

To help understand the concept of relativity mentioned in your text, imagine time as a river. In our everyday lives, we assume this river flows at a constant speed for everyone, everywhere. However, Einstein’s theory of relativity suggests that this river can actually speed up or slow down depending on how fast you are moving or how strong the gravity is around you.

Think of it like a video game character running at super speed. To the character, the game world looks normal, and their own actions feel like they are happening at a regular pace. But if you, the player watching from outside the screen, look at the character, it might seem like they are moving in slow motion compared to the rest of the world. Similarly, if you were on a train moving incredibly close to the speed of light, your personal experience of time would feel completely normal. But to someone standing still outside the train, it would appear as though your clock is ticking much slower than theirs. This isn't an illusion; it is a fundamental property of how time and space are connected.
